        ],
        'subtotal': '819.60',

    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, invoice_data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = invoice_data['vendor']
        for item in invoice_data['items']:
            writer.writerow([
                invoice_id,
                vendor,
                item['description'],
                item['qty'],
                item['unit_price'],
                item['line_amount']
            ])

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for invoice_id, invoice_data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        # Use Decimal for precise calculations
        subtotal = Decimal(invoice_data['subtotal'])
        tax = Decimal(invoice_data['tax'])
        printed_total = Decimal(invoice_data['total'])

        # Calculate difference
        difference = computed_total - printed_total
        
        # Determine status
        status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
        
        writer.writerow([
            invoice_id,
            invoice_data['subtotal'],
            invoice_data['tax'],
            invoice_data['total'],
            str(computed_total),
            str(difference),
            status
        ])

print("Processing complete!")
print("\nItems extracted to items.csv")
print("Reconciliation written to reconciliation.csv")

# Check for discrepancies
discrepancies = []
for invoice_id, invoice_data in sorted(invoices.items()):

    tax = Decimal(invoice_data['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(invoice_data['total'])
    computed_total = subtotal + tax
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    if difference != 0:
        discrepancies.append(f"Invoice {invoice_id}: difference = {difference}")

if discrepancies:
    print("\n⚠️ DISCREPANCIES FOUND:")
    for disc in discrepancies:
        print(f"  - {disc}")
else:
    print("\n✓ All invoices reconciled successfully - no discrepancies found")
